About the Top PC Games chart

AnkerGames lists free pre-installed PC games you can grab by direct download, with no Steam, no launcher and no installer to run. This chart ranks that entire library by real all-time downloads, so the order reflects genuine demand rather than editorial picks or paid placement.

Next to every title you can see how many downloads it has taken this week plus a heat reading, so the enduring giants and the classics quietly surging back are both easy to spot.

Frequently asked questions

Purely by all-time downloads of the published build. A game climbs as more players download it. There is no manual weighting, no editorial pick and no paid placement.

Yes. Every game in the chart is a free pre-installed build with a direct download link, so you do not need Steam, a launcher or an installer to play it.

Heat compares a game's downloads this week against its all-time total. A high reading means a title is punching well above its lifetime weight right now, often an older classic having a resurgence.

Top ranks by all-time downloads, the enduring favourites. Trending ranks purely by the last seven days, surfacing what is surging right now rather than what has the deepest history.
